title: 65 corrections to human evolution as a planted marker

tellings.quote: is stuff like you know, the aliens had made 65 corrections to um you know, in the evolution of humans and things and

plain: Bob Lazar says he worked around 1988 and 1989 at S-4, a secret site in the Nevada desert, where he was shown briefing papers. Speaking to a podcast host, Jesse Michels, he says that a man he calls Barry told him the papers stated that aliens had made 65 corrections to human evolution. If true, it would mean humans were shaped on purpose by visitors.
